lines: A breathtaking scene
A fleeting mental image
Fill our viewfinder and look so beautiful
Though it doesn't really matter
Like, like, like, like
Snap it, flash it, float it, doll it up
Stretching myself right now in an angel world
The desire to love my unstable self
I want to show it, I want to show it, crescendo
Trends, in short, are all much the same
A narrow, filtered world
Even the passion that loved the unadorned you
I don't need it, I don't need it, decrescendo
Love spoken before it is tasted is instant
Today too, I end up wanting even your heart
Study the photogenic techniques, GO
Like, like, even if I try to love it
Like, like, go ahead as you please
Like, like, actually I don't care
Like, like, both love and hate
A breathtaking scene
A fleeting mental image
Blurs the viewfinder of muddy days
And looks so beautiful
The emotions that connect in an instant
The "I love you" I sent to you
Was it actually supposed to be different?
Though it doesn't really matter
Trends? Fashion? I don't really get it
But still, I reach out a little to be fashionable
Even I should be able to do it!
First, the very first step
Casually yearning, easily posting
Applying effects to make even someone like me look cool, I want to summit heaven
I registered on a whim right away
But I have no friends to tag
Location info? Ah, I can't read maps
Is this the baptism of the SNS world?
Desperately surviving and putting in effort
I am right here, look at me, world!
If it caught your eye, press it, get pressed, and say "like"
Just the impulse bouncing to the sound of "love" is enough, isn't it?
Or so I think, but
I still end up chasing after whatever looks photogenic
Like, like, if you give me more
How nice, how nice, even if it is impure
With instant magic
We can connect just a little
Like, like, even if I try to love it
Like, like, go ahead as you please
Like, like, I seriously don't care
About things like the number of likes
A breathtaking scene
A fleeting mental image
Fill our viewfinder and look so beautiful
Chasing and sharing even things that don't matter
The laughter we felt was real
So a heaven that is just all about looking good
Doesn't matter anymore
Though it doesn't matter, oh no, I end up taking a photo of these flashy sweets
Like, like, like, like
Like, like, like, like
Like, like, like, like
Like, like, like, like
